A water fountain throws a jet of water. The height h (in metres) of a drop of water above the nozzle after t seconds is given by h(t) = 8t − 2t², until it falls back to the nozzle level.
(i) Find the zeroes of the polynomial h(t) = 8t − 2t². [1]
(ii) Will the graph of h against t open upwards or downwards? Give a reason. [1]
(iii) Find the height of the drop at t = 1 s and at t = 3 s. What do you observe about the two heights and the zeroes you found in (i)? [2]
OR
(iii) Find the sum and product of the zeroes of h(t) using the coefficients and check them against your answer to (i). [2]
